adjudicated.jp: 「対話なくして成立しないのだぞ」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Without dialogue you don't even come to exist!"

adjudicated.jp: 話しかけないでと辛口に言われると、話しかけたくなる。
adjudicated.en: When I'm told in harsh tones not to approach or talk, I end up wanting to get close and talk.
adjudicated.assessment: 話しかける means to speak to someone. The English repeatedly adds physical approach and closeness not stated in the source.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'When I'm sharply told not to talk to her, it makes me want to talk to her.'

adjudicated.jp: 話しかけると、また、話しかけないでと辛口に言われる。
adjudicated.en: I get close and talk to her, but once more she harshly tells me to stay away and not to talk to her.
adjudicated.assessment: The source describes speaking to her and being told again not to. 'Get close' and 'stay away' add a separate physical-distance exchange.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'When I do talk to her, she sharply tells me again not to.'
